title: Vitest fixture failure in container: workspace link excluded by `.dockerignore`
what: The prime run exited 7 because the workspace link `packages/app/node_modules/@fixture/core` was excluded by the `**/node_modules` rule of `.dockerignore`.
why: DECISIONS.md Linux container gate: container packaging bug, not an adapter bug. The rule now re-includes that one directory.
impact: Vitest adapter tests fail in the container until `.dockerignore` is fixed.
